overview: ORC SHAMAN 1-60, 23 segments, solo, quest-only (no dungeons, no elite group quests), quest log 20. Reviewed against the digests, quests.json and an XP simulation of the whole plan (build_route.py's quest_xp with the Forever XP table and its low-level penalty). DESIGN. (1) Levels 1-20 never leave Kalimdor: Valley of Trials (01), Sen'jin/Razor Hill (02), northern Durotar + Orgrimmar + Call of Fire (03), Crossroads/Ratchet + Fire Totem (04), Barrens loops, eastern Stonetalon and Thunder Bluff (05). TUGs' orc file 9-12 Orgrimmar sends orcs on the zeppelin to Tirisfal for about 3k XP of level 6-10 quests; that detour is dropped in favour of the level 10-14 Durotar chains TUGs skips (806-924 Burning Blade chain, 812/813, 834/835, 97281/97282, 99048-99051, 816) and the NEW Orgrimmar Yelmak chain. Every orc/troll-only quest in the data is used (4641, 3089, 6365-6386; 5843 has no XP). (2) From 13 on, quest blocks come from the reviewed Undead Mage route, minus mage-only quests (1943-1946, 1947/1949/1950, 1953, 1959, 8250-8252), quests whose prerequisites only an undead has done (1358, 530 needs 437-441, 480 needs 479; 95981 only if Allister offers it) and quests the undead route itself had dropped as elite-gated (3909+, 4022, 838/964/5514, 5154/5210/5181, 4808-4810, 6026). (3) Travel is rebuilt without teleports into 11 continent crossings: five Eastern Kingdoms trips (20-22 Silverpine + Tarren Mill I; 28-29 Silverpine brazier + Tarren Mill II; 30-33 Booty Bay, Stranglethorn I, Alterac, Arathi I; 37-40 Arathi II, Faldir's Cove, Badlands, Alterac Uplands, Stranglethorn II, Swamp I; 46-51 Stranglethorn III, Swamp II, Badlands II, Searing Gorge, Hinterlands, Blasted Lands) and a final one at 58 (Burning Steppes + Plaguelands), with Kalimdor blocks between them. Silithus is now a Kalimdor segment (22) before the last crossing instead of an optional finish that needed a 12th crossing. (4) Shaman class work: Call of Earth 1516-1518 at 4 (01). Call of Fire 2983 (Swart, needs 10) -> Kranal Fiss (Barrens 56.0,19.9) -> Telf Joolam (Durotar 38.5,59.0 = Barrens ~65.3,27.9: ~650 yd from both Far Watch and Ratchet) -> Reagent Pouch from Burning Blade Cultists in Dustwind Cave (Durotar 52.4,25.5) + Fire Tar from Razormane casters (Barrens 53-59,24-27) -> Minor Manifestation of Fire -> Kranal (03-04). Call of Water (chain from quests.json: 1529 -> 1530 -> 1535 -> 1536 -> 1534 -> 220 -> 63 -> 100 -> 96): 1529 from Xanis in Thunder Bluff at 20 (05), Islen + Brine brown skin (06), Tarren Mill well red skin (06), Brine + Ruins of Stardust blue skin (07), Brine + Islen (08), Brazier of Everfount (09), Islen = Water Totem at ~29 (10). Call of Air 1532 from Xanis at 30 -> Prate Cloudseer (Thousand Needles 53.5,42.6) in segment 10, with Astral Recall trained on the same Thunder Bluff stop. 96136 (NEW Call of Air) is written for Zephras shaman: only an N step at the trainer. Elemental Mastery 8410 is optional (segment 20 accept, 23 hand-in): its four elements are tradeable reagents (AH, or drops from normal elementals), Bath'rah is a short ride from Tarren Mill and 8412's parts come from WPL bears and spiders; 8413 is Sunken Temple (skip). (5) Trainers: Shikrik (2-6), Swart (6-10), Orgrimmar (12, 14/16, 28, 32/34, 40, 44/46, 50/52, 56/58), Thunder Bluff (18/20, 22/24, 24/26, 30, 36, 42/44, 54, 56), Stonard/Haromm 48.2,57.9 (38/40, 46/48, 48/50, 58) - no crossing is made just to train. Ghost Wolf at 20 (05). Astral Recall at 30 (10): a second hearth to the same bind, 15 min cooldown, written N Cast Astral Recall (back to <town>). Wolf mount: gold reminder in 13, bought from Kildar/Ogunaro (Orgrimmar 69.4,13.1 / 69.4,12.2) on the first step of 16 at 40, right off the Grom'gol zeppelin. (6) XP HONESTY (simulated, quest XP x1.35 = validator / x1.6 = typical share of kill XP): 1-30 needs no grinding at x1.6 and only small L steps at x1.35, so bands 1-30 are now real. From 30 on every segment needs grinding like the undead route did (its L steps add up to ~1.5M XP at x1.35): this plan needs ~1.2M XP (x1.6) to ~1.65M (x1.35), spent at the undead/TUGs grind spots: Boulder'gor 33, Magram 35, silithid hive/Darkmist 37, Badlands rock elementals 39, Wastewander/Lost Rigger 43, Zukk'ash/Dunemaul 46, Searing 49, Blasted Lands 51, Un'Goro/Eldarath 54, Felpaw/Winterfall 57, Corin's Crossing 60. Each segment's risks give its own estimate. Optional XP: 79007/79192 note chain (06-07), Muisek chain via a Camp Mojache flight (17/19/20, ~21k), Moonglade exit from Silithus (22, ~20k), Elemental Mastery (8.9k), cloth donations in Orgrimmar/Thunder Bluff/Undercity, Shen'dralas (NEW 35-43, Gelkis side, ~14k) and Riverglades if the logger finds their givers.

EK-internal hops (no crossing): Grom'gol -> Undercity zeppelin (seg 11), Undercity -> Grom'gol zeppelin (seg 14 -> 15), and flights. Total 11 and no optional 12th (Silithus is done in Kalimdor before crossing 11). The Undead Mage route needed about 20 including Teleports.
